items: Material：This crochet cardigan is crafted from a lightweight, breathable, and stretchy knitted fabric, offering a soft and comfortable fit perfect for spring and summer wear and and small enough to carry in a large bag or tote, making it perfect for on-the-go.

Design & Feature：The shrug cardigan features an open front, batwing sleeves, a hollow-out design, a wide placket, and a cropped length. Its unique and trendy crochet back with a "Z" pattern adds a cute and stylish touch.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: The Lightweight Summer Cardigan is great for daily life, casual, vacation, beach, work, office, school, outdoors, dating, a night at the club, or even a beach day, etc.This versatile cardigan is perfect for layering over bathing suits or beachwear and pairs effortlessly with camis, dresses, jeans, pants, skirts, shorts, and more.

items.label: Size
items.value: Available in S=US(4-6), M=US(8-10), L=US(12-14), XL=US(16-18). Size up slightly if you prefer a more relaxed drape.

items.label: Care Instructions
items.value: This women bolero cardigan is Hand wash / Do Not Bleach / Dry Flat / Do not iron.
